title: I quit my job to build this micro-saas. Now it makes $30K/month
description:
Charlie bootstrapped his micro-saas, Links, to over $30K/month, which allowed him to quit his job... twice! In this episode, he shares exactly how he grew Liinks to $30K/month (even in a saturated market), and his advice for building a side project that might help you quit your full-time job, right now in 2026

*Side project ideas you can build with your 9-5:* https://clickhubspot.com/xls2
